name: zoom-momentum
description: A Zoom App for live college lectures: AI-generated comprehension polls, a live topic timeline and glossary, and post-class recovery packs, all inside the meeting.
author: Shitij Mathur

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n client,server,mock -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w mock-transcript"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:site: VITE_BASE=/demo/ npm run build -w client && node scripts/build-site.mjs
